messages:
incident-bot: [AUTOPAGER] PagerDuty alert fired -> PD#PD12345
incident-bot: alert details: host=gpu-node-17, region=us-west-2, symptom=kernel_panic -> kubelet NotReady, multiple duplicate signals suppressed
aziz: acked. I'm on it, going to attach serial console and check dmesg. @pagerduty-bot can you suppress duplicate PD noise for 15m? :eyes:
claire: running quick k8s check
claire: ```
$ kubectl get nodes gpu-node-17 -o wide
NAME           STATUS     ROLES    AGE   VERSION
gpu-node-17    NotReady   gpu      120d  v1.28.2
```
claire: `kubectl describe node gpu-node-17` shows Kernel panic entry at 03:12:14 UTC, kubelet heartbeat lost ~03:11:52
nate: recommend cordon + drain before we try any remote reboot. will prepare drain cmd and watch scheduling.
nate: ```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-17
kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=60
```
maria: checking customer impact: dashboards show no cluster-wide 5xx spike. however one long-running embedding job from acme-inc failed around the same time (job-id: job-87541). opening CS ticket and flagging for retries.
aziz: cordon done. drain in progress -> moved 12 pods, 2 pods pending (local-storage). holding on pod eviction for those two.
pagerduty-bot: PD#PD12345 status -> acknowledged by aziz (L1). Auto-escalation triggered after 8m -> escalated to L2.
oncall-l2: taking over. pinging infra for serial console access and RMA readiness. can someone paste the serial excerpt if available?
aziz: pasting serial output excerpt: ```
[    0.000000] Kernel panic - not syncing: Machine check
[    0.000123] CPU: 0 PID: 1 Comm: systemd Not tainted 5.19.0-rc1
[    0.000456] Hardware error: 0x9 (MCE)
```
oncall-l2: looks hardware-level, opening RMA (RMA#RMA9876). scheduling replacement and maintenance window. tagging infra oncall and storage team for the two local-storage pods.
maria: CS notified, ticket created: CS-7432 (impacted tenant acme-inc). draft proactive message posted to CS channel for review.
cs-lead: saw the draft, will reach out to acme-inc in 10 minutes. please include job-id and whether data persisted to object storage.
aziz: reboot attempted via IPMI, node fails to boot cleanly (kernel oops on early init). leaving node cordoned and marking for replacement.
oncall-l2: handover notes -> RMA in progress, replacement ETA 6 hours, follow-ups: (1) ensure failed embedding job job-87541 is retried, (2) confirm local-storage pod recovery plan, (3) update incident doc inc-6192001111 with serial logs and RMA ticket. handing off to morning shift at 07:00 PST.
maria: added follow-up tasks to incident doc and created a retry job for job-87541 to run overnight; flagged billing for potential credits if job needs rerun. :white_check_mark:
aziz: dropping a short postmortem template pointer: /incidents/inc-6192001111/draft — will fill in timeline and root-cause once RMA completes.
cs-lead: CS will escalate outreach if the replacement ETA slips beyond 8h. keeping customer loop tight.
aziz: thanks all — wrapping this pager. I'll post final summary and move to postmortem channel when we have RMA closure. :bow:
